g.aria-label: Static Pre-Allocated Cache Buffer (B, H_kv, T_max, d_h) per Block
Why Static Shapes + In-Place Writes Are Mandatory for Fast Compilation
1. Dynamic concatenation inside a token loop
reallocates memory and forces recompilation every step.
2. Fixed buffer address + RoPE offset t + boolean
mask (idx ≤ t) lets the compiler build the step once!
